zh-CN.name: Wot UI
zh-CN.tagline: 轻量、美观、AI 友好的 uni-app 组件库
zh-CN.description: Wot UI（npm 包 wot-design-uni）为 uni-app 与 Vue 3 提供组件。文档在 wot-ui.cn，源码在 wot-ui/wot-ui。
zh-CN.audience: 用 uni-app 和 Vue 3 做跨端界面，需要一套现成组件而不是从 Registry 安装源码的团队。
useCases: 在 uni-app 页面里安装并使用 wot-design-uni 组件
按官方文档接入主题和 AI 辅助用法
与 weapp 工具链并存，而不是替换 Varo Registry
capabilities: MIT 许可的开源仓库 wot-ui/wot-ui

faqs.question: Wot UI 和 Varo 有什么不同？
faqs.answer: Wot UI 是安装到 uni-app 项目里的组件库。Varo 通过 Registry 把可编辑源码装进 H5 / weapp-vite 项目。职责不同，可以按目标选用。

faqs.question: 包名为什么是 wot-design-uni？
faqs.answer: npm 上的发布名是 wot-design-uni。GitHub 仓库和文档品牌使用 Wot UI / wot-ui.cn。

en.name: Wot UI
en.tagline: A light, polished, AI-friendly uni-app component library
en.description: Wot UI (npm package wot-design-uni) ships components for uni-app and Vue 3. Docs live at wot-ui.cn; source is wot-ui/wot-ui.
en.audience: Teams building uni-app + Vue 3 interfaces who want an installable component library rather than Registry-installed source.
useCases: Install wot-design-uni and use it in uni-app pages
Follow the official docs for theming and AI-assisted usage
Keep it beside the weapp toolchain instead of replacing the Varo Registry

faqs.question: How is Wot UI different from Varo?
faqs.answer: Wot UI is a component library you install into a uni-app project. Varo installs editable source through its Registry for H5 / weapp-vite. Different jobs; pick by target.

faqs.question: Why is the package named wot-design-uni?
faqs.answer: That is the npm publish name. The GitHub repository and docs brand use Wot UI / wot-ui.cn.
